title: Clock Hand Coincidence Between 3 and 4 O’clock
subject: Mathematics
caption: Clock hands overlapping between 3 and 4 o’clock, showing the ~98.4° angle and ~16 minutes past 3.
altText: A white circular clock face with radius 150 centered at (200,200). Tick marks indicate 12, 3, 6, and 9 o’clock. The hour hand (thick) and minute hand (thin) extend from the centre to points at about 98.4° clockwise from the 12‑o’clock position, representing the time roughly 3:16 when the hands coincide. A red arc from the 12‑o’clock direction to the hand direction is labeled “≈98.4°”. A blue label near the minute hand reads “≈16 min”. The title appears at the top of the diagram.
